diagnosis: The route handler fetches compliance archive exports from S3 using exportId from the query parameters. While it requires session authentication, it does not check whether exportId belongs to the caller's organization. An authenticated auditor or employee can download confidential SOC2 compliance packages, system audit trails, and employee records of other client companies.
exploit_request:
GET /api/v1/compliance/export?exportId=exp_global_corp_soc2_2025 HTTP/1.1
Host: compliance.auditready.io
Cookie: authjs.session-token=<attacker_cookie>
